component.name: Snipunix (Beta)
component.summary: Beta build of the Snipunix screenshot tool

description.p: This is the beta channel of Snipunix, the GNOME screenshot, annotation, and screen-recording tool. It is installed next to the stable release, keeps its own settings and its own portal permissions, and can be installed side by side with it.

The beta exists so that new behaviour can be tried on real machines before it reaches the stable channel. Expect rough edges: the feature set matches the stable release of the moment, but new work lands here first.
Everything still happens on your machine. There is no telemetry, nothing is uploaded, and the only network request is an explicit, user-initiated download of the OCR models for host builds.
Please report problems in the issue tracker. Attach the diagnostics report from Settings → About, or the output of snipunix --diagnostics. It contains no screen content and no recognised text.
The first beta of the 0.6 release candidate: translations, the diagnostics export, opt-in crash reports, and the packaging and documentation work.
